limitations.note: The rewrite computes the correct credit totals for the two faulty transitions, but it also replaces the rising-edge state machine with falling-edge credit updates, samples `sel`, and restricts dispensing to the high clock phase.

limitations.quote: Pulses must end at the falling clock edge
limitations.note: The testbench enforced the rewrite’s half-cycle output timing and coin-counting rules instead of checking the two faulty transitions while preserving the original output behavior.

limitations.quote: Passed directed cases and 10,000 random cycles
limitations.note: Running 10,000 cycles against a model that shared the rewrite’s assumptions added no evidence that the original behavior was preserved.
